sources.text: L0 챗봇은 규칙이나 프롬프트 매칭으로 텍스트만 출력하며 스스로 정하는 것이 없다. L1 비서 봇은 명령과 맥락으로 정해진 API 실행 여부만 판단한다. L2 코딩 서브에이전트는 격리 샌드박스에서 구현·검증 절차를 스스로 결정한다. L3 AI 에이전트는 목표가 주어지면 계획과 도구 호출 순서를 스스로 수립한다. 자율성은 에이전트가 스스로 정하는 범위로 본다. 인증 전 초안은 정당화가 없는 추측이므로 지식이 아니다. 사람은 승인·교정·인증으로 개입한다.

sources.label: Feng, K. J. K. et al. (2025). Levels of Autonomy for AI Agents. arXiv:2506.12469
sources.text: We define five levels of escalating agent autonomy, characterized by the roles a user can take when interacting with an agent: operator, collaborator, consultant, approver, and observer. Autonomy is treated as a deliberate design decision separate from the agent's capability. We propose autonomy certificates to govern agent behavior in single- and multi-agent systems. Human-in-the-loop designs let users approve, correct, or take over agent actions.

sources.label: Sarasvathy, S. D. (2001). Causation and Effectuation. Academy of Management Review 26(2)
sources.text: Saras D. Sarasvathy, Causation and Effectuation: Toward a Theoretical Shift from Economic Inevitability to Entrepreneurial Contingency, Academy of Management Review 26(2):243–263, 2001. Causation processes take a particular effect as given and select between means to create that effect. Effectuation processes take a set of means as given — who I am, what I know, and whom I know — and focus on selecting between possible effects.

sources.label: Gettier, E. L. (1963). Is Justified True Belief Knowledge? Analysis 23(6)
sources.text: Edmund L. Gettier, Is Justified True Belief Knowledge?, Analysis, Vol. 23, No. 6 (1963), pp. 121–123. The traditional analysis holds that S knows that P if and only if P is true, S believes that P, and S is justified in believing that P. Gettier presents two cases in which a person has a justified true belief that is true only by luck, and argues that the person does not know the proposition.
